questions.a: The cairn device is NOT system_rackmount — the host is the laptop, cairn is the project. Different scopes, different devices.
The trouble panel is the cairn device's FIRST pane. Circuit breakers for all devices are the second (child b of the intention, a later ticket).
Dynamic means client-side interaction (click-to-select, live refresh via WebSocket). The current stdlib web_server cannot do this — depends on the Starlette migration.
READ-ONLY surface. No editing or closing troubles from the panel — that is the trouble lane's own door, not a panel's.
